headline: Peacock is raising prices by up to $3
summary: Peacock is increasing prices across its streaming plans again. The ad-supported Select tier will rise from $7.99 to $8.99/month. The ad-free Premium Plus plan sees the biggest hike.

headline: Coyote vs. Acme is even funnier because Warner Bros. Discovery tried to kill it
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery attempted to shelve the 'Coyote vs. Acme' movie. This move inadvertently drew more attention and interest to the film. The situation highlights WBD's controversial strategy of disappearing completed movies.

headline: Comcast is turning millions of its routers into motion detectors
summary: Comcast is enabling Wi-Fi motion sensing on millions of existing customer routers. The devices will function as activity monitors at no additional cost. This new feature is part of Comcast's Xfinity Shield service.

headline: ABC sues the FCC over Trump and Carr’s campaign of threats
summary: ABC is suing the FCC, alleging a 'retaliatory campaign' against its networks. The lawsuit claims the FCC threatened ABC's broadcast licenses over content. Disney, ABC's parent company, accuses the FCC of punishing free speech.

headline: gamescom 2026: How to Watch and Daily Schedule of the Biggest Gaming Event
summary: Gamescom 2026, the biggest gaming event, is approaching. Details on how to watch the event have been released. A full daily schedule is now available for viewers.

headline: Xbox Game Pass August 2026 Wave 2 Lineup Announced
summary: Microsoft has announced the Xbox Game Pass August 2026 Wave 2 lineup. The new selection includes multiple day-one releases. Subscribers can look forward to fresh titles joining the service.

headline: The Best Pixel 11 Cases to Protect Your New Phone
summary: A guide to the best Pixel 11 cases for new phone protection is available. Options include rugged, clear, and leather styles. These cases offer essential defense against fall damage.

headline: LEGO Batman Returns Batmobile Set Officially Announced
summary: LEGO has officially announced the first-ever Batman Returns Batmobile set. The new model features numerous hidden details and easter eggs from the movie. Collectors can anticipate a detailed replica of the iconic vehicle.

headline: UK 'supports Ukraine 100%', Burnham says, after Russia's drone warning
summary: Russia accuses the UK of escalating the Ukraine war by supplying drones. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham pledges '100%' support for Kyiv. He vows to stand with Ukraine in its 'hour of need.'

headline: British couple on honeymoon killed in helicopter crash on Greek island
summary: A British couple on their honeymoon died in a helicopter crash on a Greek island. The newlyweds, Alexander Cromie and Marie Ebert, were killed alongside their pilot. The tragic incident occurred during their trip.

headline: Serco employee charged with misconduct over sharing asylum seeker addresses in Thetford
summary: A Serco employee has been charged with misconduct in public office. The 62-year-old man allegedly shared asylum seeker addresses in Thetford. He is set to appear before magistrates regarding the accusations.

headline: PM says he's not embarrassed about hoax message exchange
summary: The Prime Minister engaged in a hoax message exchange with an impersonator. He communicated with someone posing as Donald Trump's chief of staff, Susie Wiles. The PM stated he is not embarrassed by the incident.
